messages.text: Repairs at Moss Bridge finished at 11:00 UTC.
I am heading back to Willow Camp.

main_story.headline: Moss Bridge restoration work concludes
main_story.lede: Crews have successfully completed structural repairs on the local crossing, restoring full travel access for the region.
main_story.body: Following maintenance efforts, the Moss Bridge was officially reopened to the public on June 1 at 11:00 UTC. The technical work involved the installation of six oak planks to address critical wear. Tova and Eli confirmed the conclusion of the project, noting that the structure is now fully functional. With the site secured, Eli has departed the area to return to Willow Camp.

image.caption: View of the completed repairs at Moss Bridge.
